sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Personnel Security Policy establishes screening and access termination requirements for personnel associated with {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies across the system boundary described as {boundary} to safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information including {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Personnel Screening

questions.prompt: How are individuals screened prior to authorization for access to systems containing CUI?

sections.body: Individuals are screened prior to receiving authorization for access to organizational systems containing CUI through {screening_process}.

sections.heading: 3. Access Termination and Transfer Protection

questions.prompt: What policy or process governs credential and access revocation upon personnel actions?
How are access and credentials revoked coincident with personnel termination or transfer?
How is the system protected during and after personnel transfer actions?

sections.body: A formal process for terminating access and credentials coincident with personnel actions is established in {termination_policy}. System access and credentials are revoked consistent with personnel actions such as termination or transfer via {revocation_enforcement}. System protection during and after personnel transfer actions is maintained through {transfer_protection}.
